senses.gloss: m. (הָדַר, Pi.) paying respect; honoring, adorning.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 32b:9">Kidd. 32ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:32">Lev. XIX, 32</cite>) <he>קימה במקום שיש ה׳</he> rising in such a way as to show your respects (being near enough).
<cite ref="Leviticus 19:32">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ שאין בו וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01415"><he>חֶסְרוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>בהִידּוּרָהּ של תורה וכ׳</he> (<he>חד מתלמ׳</he>) <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> thou shalt die in the glory of the Law (as a great scholar), v. <cite ref="E00150"><he>הֲדָרָא</he></cite>.—<he>ה׳ מצוה</he> doing a religious act in the handsomest way.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 9b:2">B. Kam. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ מצוה עד וכ׳</he> the expense for adorning a religious act (e.g. buying a fine copy of the Law) must not exceed one third (of the ordinary expense); a. e.
